svg.title: ArtViSiON — CREATiVE: campaigns, key visuals and experience design
svg.desc: Flat vector scene in three zones: a campaign hoarding carrying the key visual and the brand lockup, the key visual assembling on an easel above its colour chips, and a lit experience portal with people walking through and the social cut on a phone. Animated. Editable layers: background, artwork, logo.
